title: Navigate Wazuh ATT&CK technique to its independently authorized Case Timeline source events
goal: Add real Class-0 per-technique event navigation from already visible Wazuh source-cohort counts using the SAME existing bounded `/demo-wazuh-drilldown` endpoint, original Case/Timeline/typed-source authorization, and original source opener; no new policy, parser, output privilege, network listener or duplicate engine.
invariants: The Wazuh `rule.mitre.id` tag is untrusted source-claimed annotation, not a verified ATT&CK observation nor a permission or Case relation.
Only matches in the independently owner-authorized Case/Timeline/typed-source traversal are returned; complete authorized import set must be checked before writing any response.
Reuses source `wazuhRuleLevels` and existing HTTP `/demo-wazuh-drilldown` selector semantics; no second importer or new engine.
Technique selector strictly Tdddd/Tdddd.ddd; cannot combine with agent/rule or arbitrary authorization query keys. Explicit `case_id` and optional page offset reauthorized every request.
Only projected Event ID/kind/time are returned; sensitive raw alert IDs/names/full_log/preview never output; source open requires separate independent authorization.
Client validation is presentation only; forged response mismatch or selection/token revision refuses rendering and reuses existing source open to recheck rights.
Keep historical #218 HEAD 930f41987d00f74f31f7706f91d43d5a144581c2 unchanged during L2, no modification of parent PR #217 or full product spec.
security_properties: Deny invalid combinations, duplications, lower-case/unbounded labels, different Case, unknown query keys and page bounds without leaks.
Use existing per-page owner traversal and context cancellation, no downstream owner trust given to user-provided Wazuh tag.
Existing no-store, same-origin bearer, redirection refusal and source-owner rechecks remain unchanged; no production IAM claim.

migration.rationale: Existing ephemeral offline Wazuh source and existing /demo-wazuh-drilldown route; no schema change.

rollback.strategy: Revert additive technique selector and UI button, leaving agent/rule intersection, Wazuh cohort counts and historical source unchanged.
verification: No new provider or mutable data

inputs: CAP-INV-110 source navigation and permission requirements
Existing E10-INV-120C-MITREFIX IMPLEMENTED source metadata validation and top-ten cohort display
Existing `wazuh_drilldown.go` reauthorized agent/rule paging plus analyst.js owner-checked source navigation
outputs: Click an existing source-claimed ATT&CK cohort label to retrieve 25-at-a-time permitted Case Timeline IDs through same HTTP endpoint and open one via same source owner checks.
No matching visible entries returns count zero rather than invented observed technique.
Deny forged mixed selector or malicious server response before any Event rendered.
acceptance_tests: Genuine source T1059.001 on 53 local Wazuh alerts yields 27 deduplicated source-authorized matches paginated 25+2, not 53 and not raw source IDs.
Wrong tenant/Case, anonymous request, duplicated/mixed/malformed technique filter, unknown key, bad offset: generic denial with no source events.
Existing agent/rule/agent+rule selector modes remain unchanged and must pass existing tests.
Node 24 analyst browser cohort button triggers same-origin authorized GET with technique_id, no bearer in URL, paged response display and source reauthorization on open.
Mismatched server selector fails closed with no partial returned Event IDs.
Go tests, vet, Linux race, Node and mandatory global engineering checks pass on exact PR SHA.
definition_of_ready: Parent code source and owner authorization available on frozen #218, no class-2 operations or new source decision required
Single source read-only event-navigation behavior, bounded by 5000 events and maximum 25 per page
definition_of_done: Demonstrable source-backed owner-checked technique-to-event drilldown in the existing browser and Go HTTP handler
Exact HEAD Go/Node multi-platform and engineering checks pass, material L2 separately reviewed if required
PR remains Draft, no false full CAP acceptance or production status

performance_budget.rationale: Uses existing ≤8MiB local source and ≤5000 authorized Timeline entries; traverses existing owner chain per request, bounded 25 results per page. No production SLO measured.
